newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Clovis USD, Calif..
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Clovis USD, Calif..

text.p: NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN, pursuant to California Government Code Section 53692, that the Board of Supervisors of the County of Fresno, California, in the name of the Clovis Unified School District (the District''), intends to sell, at public sale, not to exceed $28,000,000 Clovis Unified School District 1997 Tax and Revenue Anticipation Notes. Bids will be received on

or, at the election of the District on June 10, 1997, June 17, 1997, or on such other date as shall be established by the District and noticed in Munifacts, in all cases at 10:00 a.m., at the office of Seidler-Fitzgerald Public Finance, 515 South Figueroa Street, Eleventh Floor, Los Angeles,

California 90071, and the sale will be awarded by the Deputy Superintendent of the District, on behalf of the District, within 48 hours after the expiration of the time prescribed for the receipt of bids.
